trigger_or_context: You want to talk to a friend or make plans with them.
short_term_function: Reaching out first keeps the friendship going from your side.
developmental_cost: You never get to see if the friend would reach out too.
adaptive_alternative_1: Reach out when you want to. Then leave some space and see if they reach back before you reach again.
what_new_response_supports: You get to see if the friendship goes both ways, or only one way.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: It might feel quiet for a while. You may learn a friend will not reach back.
context_conditions: Reaching out first is fine sometimes. This is about when it is always you. A friend may also be going through a hard time.
review_reason: Cross-Phase source gap: no competency cleanly maps. Maintaining role is inferred from the one-sided-friendship context, so function is stated only in its narrow, supported form.
